weight.formula: gaugeStates(g).point resolved to the sample time

weightFlow.formula: W(t) - W(t-1h) resolved to t (allocations in minus out, decay removed)

feeYield.unit: token wei per VP wei x 1e24
feeYield.formula: delta of FeeDistribution.feeRewardPerVotingPower over the hour

incentiveRate.formula: sum of IncentiveStreaming rate of programs active at the sample time

yieldPerWeight.unit: token wei per VP wei per hour x 1e24
yieldPerWeight.formula: feeYield + sum(rate x active seconds in the hour) x 1e6 / vote supply

relayAllocatedAmount.formula: sum of allocations of relay-owned veNFTs (relayConfig().tokenId)

allocationHhi.formula: 10000 x sum((a_i / sum a)^2) over the booked allocations a_i on the gauge
